title: Back by November First
十一月一日重新開張
paras: After eleven years, Maria Chen's shop had a cracked floor and gray walls. She decided to {{renovate|renovate}} before the holiday season. "Six weeks, and we'll be done," promised Mr. Banks, the {{contractor|contractor}} she hired. His crew started the {{renovation|renovation}} in September. Maria carried all her rolls of {{fabric|fabric}}, the cotton and wool she sold to tailors, into her garage and hung a sign on the door: "Closed {{temporarily|temporarily}}. Back soon!"
十一年過去，瑪麗·陳那間店的地板裂了，牆面也灰灰舊舊的。她決定在節慶旺季前整修。「六個星期就能完工，」她請來的承包商班克斯先生保證。九月，他的工班開始施工。瑪麗把賣給裁縫師的棉布和羊毛布料一捲捲搬進車庫，並在店門口掛上告示：「暫停營業，很快回來！」

In week three, the floor {{tile|tiles}} arrived in the wrong color: green, not white. Joel, the {{painter|painter}}, had finished the walls the week before, so the floor stayed bare. The {{completion|completion}} date slid from October 15 to the end of the month, and Mr. Banks admitted the job would take {{considerably|considerably}} longer than promised.
第三週，新的地磚送來了，顏色卻送錯，要白色的卻是綠色。油漆工喬上週就把牆刷完了，地板因此一直空著。完工日期從十月十五日拖到月底，班克斯先生也承認，這份工作要花的時間比他當初說的長上許多。

Maria had already mailed flyers saying the shop would {{reopen|reopen}} with a sale on November 1. That was her {{deadline|deadline}}. After that, shoppers would go elsewhere. "Can't you speed this up somehow?" she asked.
瑪麗已經寄出傳單，寫著十一月一日將重新開張並舉辦特賣。那就是她的最後期限，過了那天，顧客就會去別家了。「你們不能想辦法趕一趕嗎？」她問。

Mr. Banks thought about it. The next morning, he found a supplier who could deliver white tiles in three days and hired a second crew. The floor was done by October 30, and Joel touched up the walls. On November 1, Maria unlocked the door at nine, and the first customer ran her hand over a bolt of blue wool and smiled.
班克斯先生想了想。隔天早上，他找到一家能在三天內送來白色地磚的供應商，還多請了一組工班趕工。地板在十月三十日前鋪好，喬再補刷牆面。十一月一日早上九點，瑪麗打開店門，第一位客人伸手撫過一捲藍色羊毛布，露出了微笑。
